schema:accessibilitySummary: This publication contains no video or audio. Most content images have alt text. Most complex images, some of which are followed by links to their long descriptions, which are housed on separate pages located in the last chapter of the eBook named Accessibility Content: Text Alternatives for Images. Asides and other regions are used to demarcate chunks of content that are visually distinguished from the basic text. The Table of Contents page contains links to all chapters listed. Within the text, references to figures, sections, other pages, etc. are created as links to that content. This eBook also contains samples of coding, set in a blockquote tag.
